offers_products.reason: Sells engineering, IT and staffing services; no main product line apart from incidental equipment design work.

offers_services.reason: Engineering, healthcare and school nurse staffing, IT and life sciences consulting are its main offerings.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are businesses, hospitals, schools, utilities and government; no individual buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves commercial and government clients, aerospace firms, energy utilities, healthcare institutions and schools.

recurring_revenue.reason: Staffing placements and ongoing engineering and consulting engagements with repeat clients, citing over 95% retention.

cyclical_demand.reason: Staffing and engineering project spending in aerospace, energy and industry can be cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Billed hourly staffing and consulting engagements, which are small and frequent rather than large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Clients pay for engineers, nurses, and consultants' time and skill; the service stops without staff.

large_customers.reason: Main clients are aerospace and defense firms, utilities, large healthcare institutions, pharma and government agencies.

asset_heavy.reason: Staffing and engineering consulting need offices and people, not plants or fleets.

notes: Thermal Kinetics designs equipment systems, but the business is mostly staffing and engineering services.
